data.name: Infirmary Access
data.description: As long as you are able to rest in a church or monastery dedicated to your deity, you and %1 allies can receive magical healing for free. When you use this ability, you and your allies heal %2 hit points damage overnight (this healing comes primarily from channeled energy and cure light wounds spells from low-ranking priests in the building). You can gain these benefits %3 times each weak.|MonasteryFame/5|MonasteryFame|max(1,MonateryFame/10)
